title: Spreading a finite etale Galois cover
statement:
Let $S$ be a
quasi-compact and
quasi-separated integral
normal scheme with generic point $\eta$. Let
$C\to S$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
smooth morphism with
geometrically connected
fibres, and fix a section $\sigma:S\to C$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$
be a finite etale
Galois cover with group
$G$, assume $|G|$ is
invertible on $S$, and assume $Z$ has a $\kappa(\eta)$-rational point
mapping to $\sigma(\eta)$. Then there is a finite etale
Galois cover
$\widetilde Z\to C$ with group $G$ whose restriction to $C_\eta$ is the
given cover $Z\to C_\eta$.
(*Stacks Project, Fundamental Groups of Schemes, [Tag `0EZJ`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EZJ) = Lemma 58.31.9.*)

proof.text: Put $K=\kappa(\eta)$ and form the generic fibre $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}K$, $j:C_\eta\to C$. The pullback universal property applied to $(1,i\sigma)$ gives $s_\eta$ with $s_\eta q=1$ and $s_\eta j=i\sigma$, since $\sigma c=1$. Apply lem-sbc-underlying-finite-etale-extension to the given $G$-torsor and its point over $s_\eta$. Its hypotheses are exactly the qcqs, normal integral, smooth geometrically connected, section and invertible-order hypotheses here. Obtain a finite etale surjective $\pi:P\to C$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ with cartesian generic square. This uses the existing underlying-extension node, whose Noetherian approximation and Noetherian extension dependencies carry the limit, trait and depth-two parts of the unit route.

source.place: Tag 0EZJ, lemma-extend-covering-general; Tag 0EYJ, lemma-extend-covering, extension of the group action

proof.text: Apply lem-sbc-generic-fibre-action-extension to this $\pi$ and cartesian square. The base and family satisfy its normal integral, smooth and geometrically connected hypotheses; finiteness and etaleness of $\pi$ came from step 1. Obtain maps $a_g$ over $C$, $a_1=1$, $a_{gh}=a_h;a_g$, and $g_Z;\psi=\psi;a_g$, with $\coprod_{g\in G}P\to P\times_C P$, component $(a_g,1)$, an isomorphism. No connectedness of $Z$ or $P$ is needed.

source.place: Tag 0EZJ, lemma-extend-covering-general; Tag 0EYJ, lemma-extend-covering, extension of the group action

proof.text: Give $P$ the action $g\mapsto a_g$. The laws in step 2 give inverses $a_{g^{-1}}$, so these are automorphisms over $C$; being isomorphisms, they are finite etale. On each geometric fibre the displayed isomorphism says that for every ordered pair of points there is exactly one $g$ taking the second to the first; the fibre is nonempty by surjectivity in step 1. Thus this is precisely a finite etale $G$-torsor, the Galois-cover notion of def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois. In the quotient-sheaf description the same identity identifies the action relation with $P\times_C P$, so its quotient is $C$: locally lift a section of $C$ to the covering $P$, and two lifts differ by exactly one $g$. An invariant morphism out of $P$ has equal composites with the two projections from this relation, so its local values on these lifts agree and glue uniquely; this is also the categorical quotient property. Set $\widetilde Z=P$ with this action. The cartesian square of step 1 identifies its restriction with $Z$, and the equations of step 2 make that identification $G$-equivariant. These are the required clauses.
